title: v0.9.2 - Graceful Entitlements & Unified Error Handling
description: This release focuses on user experience stability, introducing a graceful flow for experimental feature access, smarter entitlement checks, and a refactored API client for precise error handling.

items.title: Graceful Experimental Access
items.description: A polished flow for managing premium feature entitlements.
details: Intelligent Upgrades: Users are now guided through a Pro+ upgrade modal when accessing restricted experimental features.
Access Status Differentiating: Backend now distinguishes between tier limitations, pending reviews, and metadata sync issues.
Safe State Management: Integrated WorkOS metadata and manual database grants into a unified access controller.

items.title: Theme-Aware Identity Branding
items.description: Polished visual personality for the authentication suite.
details: Dynamic Assets: The Sign-In page now automatically toggles between dark and light GitHub branding to match your system theme.
Visual Consistency: Ensures maximum contrast and readability across high-brightness and dark modes.

items.title: Enhanced Dashboard Visuals
items.description: Granular control over how your data is visualized and presented.
details: Line Chart Precision: Fine-tune line thickness, point radius, and style (dashed/dotted).
Dynamic Trend Coloring: Line segments now automatically colorize based on slope (Green for rising, Red for falling).
Bar Chart Flexibility: New controls for bar thickness, border radius, and dataset stacking.
UX Toggles: Instantly hide or show legends and tooltips per element.

items.title: Smarter API Error Handling
items.description: A fundamental shift in how the frontend communicates with the Pegasus engine.
details: Preserved Context: The API Client now captures full HTTP status codes and JSON error bodies, enabling 'smart' UI reactions.
Real-time Entitlement Sync: Added proactive subscription fetching on critical settings tabs to ensure data accuracy.

items.title: Cleaned Production Settings
items.description: Streamlining the administrative interface for end-users.
details: Developer Sanitization: Removed legacy debug actions and crash tests from the General settings tab.
Lint-Free Stability: Resolved complex TypeScript mismatches in connection forms for smoother session performance.

items.title: Polished Statistic Styling
items.description: A more intuitive and spacious interface for critical metrics.
details: Dedicated Color Space: Moved text color configuration to a standalone 'Colors' tab for statistics.
Immersive Color Picker: Introduced a full-width, full-height inline color picker for precise UI tailoring.
Streamlined Editor: Automatically hides irrelevant chart categories when editing simple metrics.

items.title: Intelligent Query Routing
items.description: Dynamic multi-database context resolution for federated queries.
details: Cross-Database Awareness: The engine now automatically routes queries to specialized adapters (e.g. CosmosDB for OrionMetrics) regardless of the primary connection.
Visualization Precision: Enhanced AI prompts to prioritize hourly granularity for time-series data, ensuring high-frequency metrics (like server stats) remain readable.

items.title: Granular Status API
items.description: Enhanced metadata reporting in the backend governance layer.
details: Modified getExperimentalStatus to return specific failure 'reasons' and 'requiredTier' payloads.
Updated 403 Forbidden responses to carry diagnostic JSON instead of generic text.

items.title: Type-Safe Connection States
items.description: Deep hardening of the database connection engine.
details: Standardized reactive state for DynamoDB, BigQuery, and CosmosDB adapters.
Unified reset procedures for complex nested provider configurations.

items.title: Core Engine Stability
items.description: Resolving critical unhandled exceptions in the backend chat service.
details: Logout Loop Suppression: Fixed a missing helper function (upsertUser) that was triggering 401 Unauthorized errors and force-logging users out during AI generation.
JSON Parsing Resilience: Added robust guards against interrupted request bodies in message persistence routes.

items.title: CosmosDB Adapter Hardening
items.description: Refined the NoSQL-to-SQL translation layer for Azure metrics.
details: Prefix-Collision Fix: Resolved a bug causing double-prefixing of column names (e.g. 'c.c.status') in filtered queries.
Distinct Query Support: Added native support for 'SELECT DISTINCT' translations in the CosmosDB adapter layer.
